description: Everything the Byway atlas holds on one place: its own description, the records it traces to (OpenStreetMap, Wikipedia, Wikidata), reconciled public records (GNIS, National Register), the scenic byways that pass near it, the nearest verified lookouts, and for a place people walk to from the car (a waterfall, peak, cliff, arch, hot spring, lighthouse or trailhead) the walk in: time, path length one way and climb, with what the numbers come from. Takes the byway.world URL search_places returned, or the place's kind and slug.

slug.description: Place slug, ending in the row's 8-hex id

name: get_place
title: Get place details
